verdict.rationale: Before installing, `skills add --list` lists the skills available in a repo, and `skills use` prints the generated prompt to stdout, so a lead can preview a skill's instructions. After installing, files land in plain project directories (`./<agent>/skills/`, symlinked to a canonical copy) and `skills list` enumerates installed skills, so every file can be read on disk. However, the pre-install listing only shows skill names, not a per-file manifest of bundled scripts, and there is no dedicated inspect or diff command. Missing for 10: file-level manifest of bundled scripts and resources before install, a dedicated show/inspect command, independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
